interactions.description: the default lane deploys the collected graph in-process and attests every handle
a suite that asserted against a mocked handle cannot claim prod-readiness
the ephemeral-camp lane without a Yard is refused, never downgraded to in-process

body.message: the ephemeral-camp lane was selected without a Yard
body.remediation: pass an explicit Yard — createTestHarness({ lane: 'ephemeral-camp', yard }) — the lane never falls back to in-process

interactions.description: a deliberate 401 during readiness polling is an answer, not a propagation delay

body.message: http://127.0.0.1:44301/private answered 401; a deliberate rejection is an answer, not a propagation delay
body.remediation: fix the request (credentials, path, or method) — retrying a 400/401/403 cannot make it succeed

interactions.description: a pasted credential value in place of a brokered locator is refused

body.message: HOBO_TESTING_CAMP_CREDENTIAL_REF does not hold a secretRef locator
body.remediation: broker the credential and reference it (vault://, aws-sm://, hobo-secret://, …); a pasted token value is refused by design (ADR-0113)
